{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is a quick enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It is a stronger version of the [[Fallen]]. It has a decent amount of health and a rather fast speed. The '''Corrupted Fallen''' also has the [[Health Regen]] attribute, meaning it regenerates 2% of its max health every two seconds. The '''Corrupted Fallen''' can be spawned by the [[Fallen King]] with its ''Summon'' ability. The [[Awakened Fallen King]] was previously able to summon it using its ''Army of Chaos'' ability. ==Logbook Description== "''Corrupted Fallen were both the King's and Queen's personal servants. They stood up closest to her during the sacrifice and witnessed her final moments. The corruption crawls across their bodies, slowly consuming them as time moves on. It doesn't seem that they are bothered by this, but regular Fallen tend to stay away from them.''" ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is a corrupted version of the [[Fallen]]. It has black skin. It wears a white blindfold and appears to be crying behind it. It has multiple blue spikes on its on its body. It has two arm-bands with chains attached to it. ==Strategy== *The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is quite a step-up compared to its non-corrupted counterpart, the [[Fallen]]. While not having much of a step-up in HP, it spawns with the [[Health Regen]] attribute. This means that it should not be left on low health. Instead, it should be dealt with as soon as possible. **Applying high DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]] can take it out with ease, as well as clearing out hordes of '''Corrupted Fallens'''. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can also be useful at boosting your towers. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful at clearing out the hordes of '''Corrupted Fallens''' that appear later on. *Because of its high speed, slowing towers such as the [[Cryomancer]], [[Tesla]] and [[Freezer]] can be used to negate their speed. Though since the '''Corrupted Fallen''' does not have any immunities, any tower can be used to slow it down. *If any '''Corrupted Fallens''' leak, the [[Military Base]] can be used to catch any off-guard. Though long-ranged towers such as the [[Ranger]] can also be utilized. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CorruptedFallenRun.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) CorruptedFallenRun2.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) CorruptedFallenStun.gif|Stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1CorruptedFallen1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1CorruptedFallen2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCorruptedFallenAnim1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseCorruptedFallenAnim2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Enforcer Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Corrupted Fallen''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Player VS Player Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Corrupted Fallen''' in the game trailer.
